extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues: (1) label variants in 'species' (leading space in ' Adelie' and misspelling 'Chinstarp') were corrected using normalize_labels; (2) three rows with invalid negative flipper lengths (below minimum 170 mm) were excluded; (3) one exact duplicate row was removed. After fixes, the analysis shows 30 penguins measured on Biscoe, 13 on Dream, and 5 on Torgersen.
